## Motivation

Add [DM05](https://github.com/dexmal/opendm) support to SGLang's action API.

## Modifications

- Add the DM05 prefix encoder, action expert, checkpoint loader and input/output transforms, using Transformers Gemma3 components.
- Support the Base, LIBERO, RoboTwin2 and MEM-Robodojo-Sim checkpoints through the existing scheduler, action transports, prefix cache and CUDA Graphs.
- Add unit tests, a pinned LIBERO HTTP test and a deployment guide.

The model implementation follows [OpenDM at fe1ed79](https://github.com/dexmal/opendm/tree/fe1ed79a22d81cc1bfbeb2b4418bbb79fc75fc50).

## Accuracy Tests

- CPU regression: **260 passed, 3 skipped** (CUDA-only and synchronous-cancellation cases).
- Model tests on RTX4090: **15 passed**; existing Flux3 Action regressions: **37 passed**.
- Four checkpoints, 38 fixed-input cases: full prefix K/V and normalized actions match OpenDM eager and native CUDA Graph outputs with matching runtime versions.
- LIBERO, 40 tasks: SGLang **1,964/2,000 (98.20%)**, OpenDM **1,967/2,000 (98.35%)**. Paired difference: −0.15 percentage points; fixed-task bootstrap 95% interval: [−0.75, +0.45].

GPU, LIBERO and latency results were collected before the final input-validation, grouping and metadata fixes; the neural implementation is unchanged.

The HTTP CI case is a smoke test. Component accuracy, golden-output and performance checks are disabled pending a DM05 fixture in the pinned CI data and an H100 baseline.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

RTX4090, LIBERO, B1/H10/10 denoising steps, prefix reuse off; 2 cold requests, 10 warmups and 50 measured requests per service:

| Service | Application P50 / P95 (ms) | HTTP client P50 / P95 (ms) |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| OpenDM + JSON adapter | 192.104 / 194.071 | 234.769 / 238.929 |
| SGLang | 177.582 / 180.366 | 178.657 / 181.581 |

Application timing includes preprocessing and response encoding. OpenDM used Torch 2.11/Transformers 5.3; SGLang used Torch 2.14/Transformers 5.19. These compare the two service stacks.

Changed-file pre-commit and the documentation checks passed. Full-repository pre-commit passed all non-Rust hooks; four Rust hooks could not run without `cargo`/`rustup`, also on unmodified main.

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).

- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).

@@ -0,0 +1,161 @@
+---
+title: DM05
+description: Serve OpenDM DM05 action policies with the native SGLang multimodal runtime.
+tag: dVLA
+---
+
+DM05 maps RGB camera images, a task instruction, and robot state to a continuous
+action chunk. SGLang serves it through `multimodal_gen`: a Gemma3 multimodal
+prefix encoder produces per-layer K/V, then a time-conditioned action expert
+runs the flow-matching loop. The runtime owns checkpoint loading, action
+sampling, preprocessing, and postprocessing; it does not require an OpenDM
+installation or start a separate language-model server.
+
+## Install
+
+Use Linux with an NVIDIA CUDA GPU and install SGLang's diffusion dependencies:
+
+```bash
+git clone https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang.git
+cd sglang
+pip install -e "python[diffusion]"
+```
+
+The implementation uses the Transformers Gemma3 components included with
+SGLang's dependency versions. Run one GPU per worker. Tensor, sequence, CFG, and
+disaggregated parallelism are not supported for DM05; use independent server
+replicas when deploying on multiple GPUs.
+
+## Choose a checkpoint
+
+Each registered checkpoint selects its own deployment recipe. Keep the weights,
+processor, normalization statistics, camera names, and action horizon together.
+
+| Checkpoint | Camera keys, in order | State dimensions | Returned action shape | Parameter precision |
+| --- | --- | ---: | --- | --- |
+| `Dexmal/DM05` | `head`, `left_wrist`, `right_wrist` | 14 | `[50, 14]` | BF16 |
+| `Dexmal/DM05-libero` | `head`, `left_wrist` | 8 | `[10, 7]` | BF16 |
+| `Dexmal/DM05-robotwin2` | `head`, `left_wrist`, `right_wrist` | 14 | `[50, 14]` | BF16 |
+| `Dexmal/DM05-MEM-Robodojo-Sim` | `head`, `left_wrist`, `right_wrist` | 14 | `[50, 14]` | FP32 with BF16 autocast |
+
+The released LIBERO checkpoint's deployment horizon is **10**, even when its
+serialized configuration contains `chunk_size: 50`. The MEM recipe uses up to
+20 history images and the released Robodojo simulation prompt and normalization
+settings. It is distinct from the OpenDM MEM training demo.
+
+All recipes use 10 denoising steps by default and an internal padded action
+dimension of 32. The response crops and denormalizes actions to the selected
+robot's output dimensions. Parameter precision describes stored runtime weights;
+it does not mean every intermediate operation has that dtype.
+
+## Start the server
+
+Serve the LIBERO policy on one GPU:
+
+```bash
+CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 sglang serve Dexmal/DM05-libero \
+  --model-type diffusion \
+  --host 127.0.0.1 \
+  --port 30000
+```
+
+You can use `--revision` to pin a Hugging Face checkpoint revision. For a local
+export with an arbitrary directory name, select the matching recipe explicitly:
+
+```bash
+CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 sglang serve /path/to/libero-checkpoint \
+  --model-type diffusion \
+  --model-id DM05-libero \
+  --host 127.0.0.1 \
+  --port 30000
+```
+
+Keep `config.json`, the safetensors weights, tokenizer and processor assets,
+chat template, and `norm_stats.json` in that checkpoint directory. Loading checks
+the complete checkpoint key and tensor-shape contract. Unknown or missing robot
+normalization profiles produce an error.
+
+## Generate actions
+
+Read `GET /v1/actions/metadata` for the loaded policy's camera keys, dimensions,
+defaults, and transport capabilities. This example sends two RGB images and an
+eight-dimensional LIBERO state in the checkpoint's original units:
+
+```python
+import base64
+import io
+
+import numpy as np
+import requests
+from PIL import Image
+
+
+def png_payload(image):
+    buffer = io.BytesIO()
+    Image.fromarray(image).save(buffer, format="PNG")
+    return {"b64_json": base64.b64encode(buffer.getvalue()).decode()}
+
+
+image = np.zeros((256, 256, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
+payload = {
+    "input": {
+        "task": "pick up the black bowl",
+        "observation": {
+            "images": {
+                "head": png_payload(image),
+                "left_wrist": png_payload(image),
+            },
+            "state": np.zeros(8, dtype=np.float32).tolist(),
+        },
+    },
+    "parameters": {"seed": 7, "num_inference_steps": 10},
+    "runtime": {"output_format": "list", "return_timing": True},
+}
+response = requests.post(
+    "http://127.0.0.1:30000/v1/actions/generations",
+    json=payload,
+    timeout=120,
+)
+response.raise_for_status()
+actions = np.asarray(response.json()["data"][0]["action"]["values"])
+print(actions.shape)  # (10, 7)
+```
+
+Supply every configured camera in RGB order. Images can also be HWC arrays or
+tensor objects with `dtype`, `shape`, and `values`. Send raw state values once;
+the server applies the checkpoint's normalization and inverse action transforms.
+For the base model, supply `input.observation.robot_type`, `control_mode`, and
+`speed` for the intended pretraining condition, for example `DOS W1`, `joint`,
+and `"0.5"`.
+
+| Optional field | Behavior |
+| --- | --- |
+| `input.observation.noise` | Initial noise with shape `[horizon, 32]`, including padded dimensions. Overrides seed-based noise generation. |
+| `input.observation.history_images` | Oldest-to-newest RGB frames for the MEM recipe. Missing history slots are padded and masked. |
+| `parameters.action_horizon`, `parameters.action_dim` | Must match the loaded deployment's horizon and internal dimension. |
+| `runtime.cuda_graph` | Enables the bounded action-loop CUDA Graph cache. Prefix prefill remains eager. |
+| `runtime.prefix_cache` | Enables exact prefix lookup when the deployment's `enable_global_prefix_cache` configuration is enabled. |
+
+The shared action API also provides MsgPack HTTP, the generic
+`/v1/actions/realtime` WebSocket, and the OpenPI-compatible `/openpi/policy`
+WebSocket. Use the loaded DM05 camera and state names with those transports;
+the transport does not change the checkpoint's preprocessing or control
+conventions. See the [action transport examples](/cookbook/vla/OpenPI/Pi0.5).
+
+## Validate a deployment
+
+Compare identical images, state, prompt, and explicit initial noise when checking
+against OpenDM. Retain the complete normalized `[horizon, 32]` tensor before
+postprocessing as well as the returned robot actions. Changes to Torch,
+Transformers, attention backends, or parameter precision can change floating
+point results; matching an API shape or a single deterministic request does not
+establish benchmark success rate.
+
+For LIBERO evaluation, use the released checkpoint's 10-action chunk and the
+official DM05 benchmark's 10-step replanning interval, image orientation, state
+construction, and gripper convention. Keep these settings fixed across the
+reference and SGLang evaluations.
+
+References: [OpenDM](https://github.com/dexmal/opendm),
+[DM05 inference guide](https://github.com/dexmal/opendm/blob/main/docs/en/dm05_inference.md),
+[DM05 LIBERO evaluation guide](https://github.com/dexmal/opendm/blob/main/docs/en/dm05_libero.md).

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.pipeline_configs.base import PipelineConfig
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.task_type import ModelTaskType
+
+DM05_MODEL_IDS = (
+    "Dexmal/DM05",
+    "Dexmal/DM05-libero",
+    "Dexmal/DM05-robotwin2",
+    "Dexmal/DM05-MEM-Robodojo-Sim",
+)
+
+
+def is_dm05_model(model_path: str) -> bool:
+    """Use local checkpoint metadata before interpreting a model's name."""
+    path = Path(model_path).expanduser()
+    if path.is_dir():
+        try:
+            config = json.loads((path / "config.json").read_text())
+        except (OSError, ValueError):
+            return False
+        return isinstance(config, dict) and config.get("model_type") == "dm05"
+    normalized = str(model_path).lower().replace("\\", "/")
+    return any(normalized == name.lower() for name in DM05_MODEL_IDS)
+
+
+def dm05_model_id(model_path: str) -> str:
+    """Select deployment recipe defaults; arbitrary local exports use base defaults."""
+    normalized = str(model_path).lower().replace("\\", "/")
+    for name in reversed(DM05_MODEL_IDS):
+        short_name = name.rsplit("/", 1)[-1].lower()
+        if (
+            short_name in Path(normalized).name
+            or ("models--" + name.lower().replace("/", "--")) in normalized
+        ):
+            return name
+    return DM05_MODEL_IDS[0]
+
+
+@dataclass
+class DM05PipelineConfig(PipelineConfig):
+    """Native OpenDM action inference with checkpoint-owned Gemma3 components."""
+
+    task_type: ModelTaskType = ModelTaskType.VLA_ACTION
+    should_use_guidance: bool = False
+    enable_autocast: bool = False
+    generator_device: str | None = None
+    policy_family: str = "dm05"
+
+    action_horizon: int = 50
+    action_dim: int = 32
+    output_action_dim: int = 14
+    state_dim: int = 14
+    default_num_inference_steps: int = 10
+    materialize_dtype: str = "bf16"
+    precision_policy: str = "bf16_mixed"
+    llm_attn_implementation: str = "sdpa"
+    vision_attn_implementation: str = "sdpa"
+    action_attn_implementation: str = "sdpa"
+
+    processor_name: str | None = None
+    norm_stats_path: str | None = None
+    max_token_len: int = 1024
+    image_keys: tuple[str, ...] = ("head", "left_wrist", "right_wrist")
+    image_prompts: tuple[str, ...] = ("Head", "Left wrist", "Right wrist")
+    image_size: tuple[int, int] = (448, 448)
+    add_state: bool = True
+    n_state_bins: int = 256
+    clip_to_bounds: bool = True
+    reject_prompt_truncation: bool = False
+    normalize_task_prompt: bool = False
+    prompt_is_formatted: bool = False
+    default_robot_type: str | None = None
+    default_control_mode: str | None = None
+    default_speed: str = "0.5"
+    state_desc: tuple[str, ...] | None = None
+    use_absolute_action: bool = True
+    compose_eef_rot: bool = False
+    use_transformed_state: bool = False
+    state_layout: str = "identity"
+    denorm_state: bool = False
+    full_action_mask: bool = False
+    is_history: bool = False
+    max_history_images: int = 5
+
+    enable_global_prefix_cache: bool = False
+    prefix_cache_max_entries: int = 1
+    enable_prefix_cuda_graph: bool = False
+    enable_action_cuda_graph: bool = True
+    action_cuda_graph_max_entries: int = 4
+    empty_cache_after_prefix: bool = False
+    prefix_cache_layout_version: str = "dm05-prefix-v1"
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        self._validate_dm05_config()
+
+    def _validate_dm05_config(self) -> None:
+        for name in (
+            "action_horizon",
+            "action_dim",
+            "output_action_dim",
+            "state_dim",
+            "default_num_inference_steps",
+            "max_token_len",
+            "n_state_bins",
+        ):
+            value = getattr(self, name)
+            if type(value) is not int or value <= 0:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a positive integer")
+        if self.output_action_dim > self.action_dim:
+            raise ValueError("output_action_dim cannot exceed action_dim")
+        if self.n_state_bins < 2:
+            raise ValueError("n_state_bins must be at least 2")
+        for name in (
+            "max_history_images",
+            "prefix_cache_max_entries",
+            "action_cuda_graph_max_entries",
+        ):
+            value = getattr(self, name)
+            if type(value) is not int or value < 0:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a non-negative integer")
+        if not self.image_keys or len(set(self.image_keys)) != len(self.image_keys):
+            raise ValueError("image_keys must contain unique camera names")
+        if len(self.image_keys) != len(self.image_prompts):
+            raise ValueError("image_keys and image_prompts must have equal lengths")
+        if self.materialize_dtype not in ("bf16", "bfloat16", "fp32", "float32"):
+            raise ValueError("materialize_dtype must be bf16 or fp32")
+        if self.precision_policy not in ("bf16_mixed", "fp32_mixed"):
+            raise ValueError("precision_policy must be bf16_mixed or fp32_mixed")
+        if self.precision_policy == "fp32_mixed" and self.materialize_dtype not in (
+            "fp32",
+            "float32",
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("fp32_mixed requires FP32 model parameters")
+        for name in (
+            "llm_attn_implementation",
+            "vision_attn_implementation",
+            "action_attn_implementation",
+        ):
+            if getattr(self, name) not in ("eager", "sdpa"):
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be eager or sdpa")
+        if self.enable_prefix_cuda_graph:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "DM05 currently captures the action loop, not prefix prefill"
+            )
+
+    def check_pipeline_config(self) -> None:
+        super().check_pipeline_config()
+        self._validate_dm05_config()
+
+    def apply_checkpoint_config(self, local_path: str, payload: dict) -> None:

+    Gemma3RMSNorm,

+def linear_fp32(x: torch.Tensor, layer: nn.Linear) -> torch.Tensor:
+    with torch.autocast(device_type=x.device.type, enabled=False):
+        bias = None if layer.bias is None else layer.bias.float()
+        return F.linear(x.float(), layer.weight.float(), bias)
+
+
+def time_embedding(time: torch.Tensor, dim: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    fraction = torch.linspace(
+        0.0, 1.0, dim // 2, device=time.device, dtype=torch.float32
+    )
+    period = 4e-3 * (4.0 / 4e-3) ** fraction
+    angles = (1.0 / period * 2 * math.pi)[None, :] * time[:, None].float()
+    return torch.cat((torch.sin(angles), torch.cos(angles)), dim=-1)
+
+
+def validate_action_config(
+    action_config: Gemma3TextConfig, language_config: Gemma3TextConfig
+) -> None:
+    for name in (
+        "num_hidden_layers",
+        "layer_types",
+        "max_position_embeddings",
+        "rope_parameters",
+        "num_attention_heads",
+        "num_key_value_heads",
+        "head_dim",
+    ):
+        if getattr(action_config, name) != getattr(language_config, name):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"DM05 action and language configurations differ at {name}"
+            )
+
+
+class DM05ActionExpert(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: Gemma3TextConfig,
+        *,
+        attention_backend: str,
+        precision_policy: str,
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        if attention_backend not in ("eager", "sdpa"):
+            raise ValueError("DM05 action attention must be 'eager' or 'sdpa'")
+        self.config = config
+        self.attention_backend = attention_backend
+        self.precision_policy = precision_policy
+        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
+            Gemma3DecoderLayer(config, i) for i in range(config.num_hidden_layers)
+        )
+        self.norm = Gemma3RMSNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.rotary_emb = Gemma3RotaryEmbedding(config)
+        hidden = config.hidden_size
+        self.input_time_modulators = nn.ModuleList(
+            nn.Linear(hidden, 3 * hidden) for _ in self.layers
+        )
+        self.mlp_time_modulators = nn.ModuleList(
+            nn.Linear(hidden, 3 * hidden) for _ in self.layers
+        )
+        self.final_time_modulator = nn.Linear(hidden, 3 * hidden)
+
+    def _adaptive_norm(self, norm, x, condition, modulator):
+        variance = torch.mean(torch.square(x.float()), dim=-1, keepdim=True)
+        eps = getattr(norm, "eps", None)
+        if eps is None:
+            eps = norm.variance_epsilon
+        normalized = x * torch.rsqrt(variance + eps)
+        if self.precision_policy == "fp32_mixed":
+            modulation = linear_fp32(condition, modulator)
+        else:
+            modulation = modulator(condition.to(dtype=modulator.weight.dtype))
+        if modulation.ndim == 2:
+            modulation = modulation[:, None, :]
+        scale, shift, gate = modulation.chunk(3, dim=-1)
+        normalized = normalized * (1.0 + scale.float()) + shift.float()
+        return normalized.to(x.dtype), gate.to(x.dtype)
+

+        suffix_embeds: torch.Tensor,
+        position_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        attention_mask: torch.Tensor,
+        prefix_keys: tuple[torch.Tensor, ...],
+        prefix_values: tuple[torch.Tensor, ...],
+        condition: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        hidden = suffix_embeds
+        for index, layer in enumerate(self.layers):
+            prenorm, attention_gate = self._adaptive_norm(
+                layer.input_layernorm,
+                hidden,
+                condition,
+                self.input_time_modulators[index],
+            )
+            batch, length, _ = prenorm.shape
+            shape = (batch, length, -1, layer.self_attn.head_dim)
+            query = layer.self_attn.q_proj(prenorm).view(shape).transpose(1, 2)
+            key = layer.self_attn.k_proj(prenorm).view(shape).transpose(1, 2)
+            value = layer.self_attn.v_proj(prenorm).view(shape).transpose(1, 2)
+            query = layer.self_attn.q_norm(query)
+            key = layer.self_attn.k_norm(key)

+                query, position_ids, layer_type=self.config.layer_types[index]
+            )

+            key = torch.cat((prefix_keys[index], key), dim=2)
+            value = torch.cat((prefix_values[index], value), dim=2)

+            mask = attention_mask[..., -key.shape[-2] :]

+                attended = (

+                        repeat_kv(key, groups),
+                        repeat_kv(value, groups),
+                        attn_mask=mask == 0,
+                        scale=layer.self_attn.scaling,
+                    )
+                    .transpose(1, 2)
+                    .contiguous()
+                )
+            else:
+                attended, _ = eager_attention_forward(
+                    layer.self_attn,
+                    query,
+                    key,
+                    value,
+                    mask,

+            super().__init__()
+            self.encoded_prompts = []
+
+        def encode(self, text, **kwargs):
+            self.encoded_prompts.append(text)
+            return super().encode(text, **kwargs)
+
+    processor = PromptRecordingProcessor()
+    config = _config(
+        is_history=True,
+        normalize_task_prompt=True,
+        prompt_is_formatted=True,
+        max_token_len=220,
+        default_robot_type="Dual ARX5",
+        state_desc=(["joint"] * 6 + ["gripper"]) * 2,
+        output_action_dim=14,
+    )
+    prompt = "  move the cube " * 100
+    observation = _preprocessor(config, norm=_norm(14), processor=processor)(
+        _request(prompt=prompt, state=[0.0] * 14)
+    )
+    assert processor.encoded_prompts == [prompt]
+    assert len(processor.calls) == 2
+    assert observation.tokens.shape[1] <= config.max_token_len
+    for messages, _ in processor.calls:
+        text = messages[0]["content"][0]["text"]
+        assert "Task: move the cube" in text
+        assert ".\nHistory images:" in text
+        assert "Task: Task:" not in text
+
+
+def test_history_keeps_fixed_slots_masks_and_frame_order():
+    processor = _RecordingProcessor()
+    config = _config(is_history=True)
+    request = _request(history_images=[np.full((3, 3, 3), 128, dtype=np.uint8)])
+    observation = _preprocessor(config, processor=processor)(request)
+    text = processor.calls[0][0][0]["content"][0]["text"]
+    assert (
+        "History images: " + "<unused1>" * 16 + "<unused0>" * 16 + "\nHead image: "
+        in text
+    )
+    fields = observation.metadata["dm05"]
+    assert fields["history_mask"].sum() == 16
+    assert (observation.tokens == 7).sum() == 16
+    assert fields["token_type_ids"][fields["history_mask"]].eq(1).all()
+    assert fields["history_pixel_values"].shape == (1, 3, 8, 8)
+    assert fields["history_pixel_values"].mean().item() == pytest.approx(
+        128 / 127.5 - 1, abs=1e-7

+    empty = _preprocessor(config)(_request())
+    assert (empty.tokens == 7).sum() == 32

+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "changes,field",
+    [
+        ({"control_mode": {}}, "control_mode"),

+        ({"image_masks": [True]}, "image_masks"),
+        ({"image_masks": False}, "image_masks"),
+        ({"image_masks": {"unknown": True}}, "image_masks"),
+        ({"image_masks": {"front": 1}}, "image_masks"),
+        ({"image_masks": {"front": "true"}}, "image_masks"),
+        ({"image_masks": {"front": [True]}}, "image_masks"),
+        ({"camera_order": 7}, "camera_order"),
+        ({"camera_order": "front"}, "camera_order"),
+        ({"camera_order": ["front", {}]}, "camera_order"),
+        ({"camera_order": []}, "camera_order"),
+        ({"camera_order": ["front", "front"]}, "camera_order"),

+)
+def test_malformed_layout_and_control_fields_raise_value_errors(changes, field):
+    processor = _RecordingProcessor()
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=field):
+        _preprocessor(processor=processor)(_request(**changes))
+    assert not processor.calls
+
+
+def test_explicit_camera_order_and_boolean_visibility_preserve_valid_input():
+    preprocessor = _preprocessor()
+    implicit = preprocessor(_request())
+    explicit = preprocessor(
+        _request(
+            camera_order=["front", "wrist"],
+            image_masks={"front": True, "wrist": np.bool_(True)},
+        )
+    )
+    torch.testing.assert_close(explicit.tokens, implicit.tokens, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        explicit.metadata["dm05"]["pixel_values"],
+        implicit.metadata["dm05"]["pixel_values"],
+        rtol=0,
+        atol=0,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "changes,match",
+    [
+        ({"state": None}, "state is required"),
+        ({"state": [0.0] * 6}, "7 dimensions"),
+        ({"state": [float("nan")] * 7}, "finite"),

+)
+def test_invalid_observations_are_rejected(changes, match):

+        _preprocessor()(_request(**changes))
+
+
+def test_history_limit_and_noise_finiteness_are_checked():

+
+def test_full_mask_and_explicit_noise_are_preserved_before_denoising():

+    obs = _preprocessor(_config(full_action_mask=True))(_request(noise=noise))

+def test_prompt_truncation_retries_public_chat_template_contract():
+    processor = _RecordingProcessor()
+    _preprocessor(_config(max_token_len=250), processor=processor)(
+        _request(prompt="q" * 300)

+def test_collation_keeps_same_shape_different_content_and_per_robot_postprocessing():
+    norm_a = _norm()
+    norm_b = _norm()
+    norm_b["norm_stats"]["action"] = _stats(7, 10, 20)
+    first = _preprocessor(norm=norm_a)(_request())
+    request_b = _request(state=[0.5] * 7)
+    request_b["images"]["front"] = np.full((5, 8, 3), 127, dtype=np.uint8)
+    second = _preprocessor(norm=norm_b)(request_b)
+    assert dm05_observation_signature(first) == dm05_observation_signature(second)
+    grouped = collate_dm05_observations([first, second])
+    assert grouped.batch_size == 2
+    assert grouped.metadata["dm05"]["pixel_values"].shape == (4, 3, 8, 8)
+    assert grouped.metadata["dm05"]["action_mask"].shape == (2, 1, 32)
+    outputs = postprocess_dm05_actions(torch.zeros(2, 3, 32), grouped, _config())
+    assert outputs.shape == (2, 3, 7)
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(outputs[0], 5e-7, atol=1e-7)
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(outputs[1], 15, atol=1e-6)

+
+def test_collation_rejects_incompatible_shapes_and_empty_inputs():
+    first = _preprocessor()(_request())
+    second = _preprocessor()(_request(prompt="a different prompt length"))
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="incompatible"):
+        collate_dm05_observations([first, second])
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="empty"):

+
+def test_noise_devices_are_part_of_grouping_compatibility():
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines_core.stages.vla import (
+        VLAPrefixEncodingStage,
+    )
+
+    config = _config(enable_global_prefix_cache=False)
+    preprocessor = _preprocessor(config)
+    noise = np.zeros((3, 32), dtype=np.float32)
+    first = preprocessor(_request(noise=noise))
+    second = preprocessor(_request(noise=noise))
+    args = SimpleNamespace(
+        pipeline_config=config,
+        disable_conditioning_cache=True,
+        conditioning_cache_max_size_mb=0,
+    )
+    stage = VLAPrefixEncodingStage(
+        None,
+        None,
+        observation_collator=collate_dm05_observations,
+        observation_signature=dm05_observation_signature,
+    )
+
+    def request(observation):
+        return SimpleNamespace(
+            extra={"vla": {"observation_batch": observation}},
+            is_warmup=False,
+            generator=None,
+            action_horizon=3,
+            action_dim=32,
+            num_inference_steps=10,
+        )
+
+    assert dm05_observation_signature(first) == dm05_observation_signature(second)
+    assert collate_dm05_observations([first, second]).noise.device.type == "cpu"
+    # Meta exercises the device boundary without requiring CUDA.
+    second.noise = second.noise.to("meta")
+    assert dm05_observation_signature(first) != dm05_observation_signature(second)
+    assert stage._observation_fingerprint(request(first), args) != (
+        stage._observation_fingerprint(request(second), args)
+    )
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="incompatible"):
+        collate_dm05_observations([first, second])
+    first.noise = first.noise.to("meta")
+    assert dm05_observation_signature(first) == dm05_observation_signature(second)
+    assert collate_dm05_observations([first, second]).noise.device.type == "meta"
+
+
+def test_history_collation_keeps_empty_and_nonempty_requests_separate_in_mask():
+    processor = _preprocessor(_config(is_history=True))
+    first = processor(_request())
+    second = processor(
+        _request(history_images=[np.full((3, 3, 3), 128, dtype=np.uint8)])
+    )
+    extra = second.tokens.shape[1] - first.tokens.shape[1]
+    assert extra > 0
+    first.tokens = torch.nn.functional.pad(first.tokens, (0, extra))
+    first.token_masks = torch.nn.functional.pad(first.token_masks, (0, extra))
+    for key in ("history_mask", "token_type_ids"):
+        first.metadata["dm05"][key] = torch.nn.functional.pad(
+            first.metadata["dm05"][key], (0, extra)
+        )
+    assert dm05_observation_signature(first) == dm05_observation_signature(second)
+    grouped = collate_dm05_observations([first, second])
+    fields = grouped.metadata["dm05"]
+    assert grouped.batch_size == 2
+    assert fields["history_mask"].sum(dim=1).tolist() == [0, 16]
+    assert fields["history_pixel_values"].shape == (1, 3, 8, 8)

+def test_relative_postprocessing_retains_gripper_and_original_state():

+    assert actual.shape == (1, 3, 7)
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(actual[0, :, :6], 0.5000005, atol=1e-7)
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(actual[0, :, 6], 5e-7, atol=1e-7)

+def test_absolute_reconstruction_requires_robot_or_state_description():

+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="robot_type.*state_desc"):
+        _preprocessor(config)(_request())

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "description_source", ["request", "config", "norm", "state_desc", "relative"]
+)
+def test_absolute_reconstruction_preserves_resolved_grippers(description_source):
+    config = _config(
+        default_robot_type=None,
+        output_action_dim=14,
+        use_absolute_action=description_source != "relative",
+    )
+    norm = _norm(14)
+    request = _request(state=[0.5] * 14)
+    if description_source == "request":
+        request["robot_type"] = "DOS W1"
+    elif description_source == "config":

+        norm["default_robot_type"] = "DOS W1"

+def test_eef_preprocessing_and_absolute_rotation_keep_identity_round_trip():

+def test_eef_rotation_preserves_reference_float32_rounding():
+    # Captured from the public OpenDM transforms at fe1ed79a, NumPy 1.26.4.
+    # In particular, casting before quaternion normalization and retaining the
+    # division parentheses affects the returned actions by several FP32 ULPs.
+    fixtures = [
+        (
+            _rpy_to_axis_angle,
+            np.array([0.0, 0.0, np.pi / 2], dtype=np.float32),
+            [0, 0, 1070141402],
+        ),
+        (
+            _quaternion_to_rotvec,
+            np.array([0.71, 0.12, -0.31, 0.62], dtype=np.float64),
+            [1049125355, 3207604517, 1068509477],
+        ),
+        (
+            _rotvec_to_quaternion,
+            np.array([0.23, -0.84, 1.72], dtype=np.float64),
+            [1058143524, 1036563415, 3199680519, 1060871419],
+        ),
+    ]
+    for convert, value, expected_bits in fixtures:
+        actual = convert(value)
+        assert actual.dtype == np.float32
+        np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual.view(np.uint32), expected_bits)
+
+
+def test_eef_delta_rotation_composes_delta_before_current_rotation():
+    config = _config(
+        compose_eef_rot=True,
+        use_transformed_state=True,
+        denorm_state=True,
+        use_absolute_action=True,
+        clip_to_bounds=False,
+    )
+    norms = {
+        "norm_stats": {
+            "state": _stats(7, -np.pi, np.pi),
+            "action": _stats(7, -np.pi, np.pi),
+        }
+    }
+    state = np.array([0, 0, 0, 0, 0, np.pi / 2, 0.4], dtype=np.float32)
+    desired_delta = np.array([0, 0, 0, np.pi / 2, 0, 0, 0.3], dtype=np.float32)
+    obs = _preprocessor(config, norm=norms)(_request(state=state, control_mode="eef"))
+    noise = np.zeros((1, 3, 32), dtype=np.float32)
+    noise[..., :7] = normalize_dm05_vector(
+        desired_delta, norms["norm_stats"]["action"], clip_to_bounds=False
+    )
+    actual = postprocess_dm05_actions(noise, obs, config)
+    expected_rotation = np.array([1, -1, 1]) / np.sqrt(3) * (2 * np.pi / 3)
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(
+        actual[0, :, 3:6], np.broadcast_to(expected_rotation, (3, 3)), atol=1e-6
+    )
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(actual[0, :, 6], 0.3, atol=1e-6)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "layout,size", [("robocoliseum_g2", 16), ("robocoliseum_manipulation", 21)]

+    assert metadata["output"]["action_dim"] == actions.shape[-1]
+    joint_indices = [i for i in range(size) if i not in (7, 15)]
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(
+        actions[0, :, joint_indices],
+        np.broadcast_to(state[joint_indices, None], (len(joint_indices), 3)),
+        atol=2e-7,
+    )
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(actions[0, :, [7, 15]], 0, atol=1e-7)
